description: Pattern on points (Array Type=Points): one copy of the body at every point, turned so its up axis follows the point's axis when the point has one. points is [[x, y, z], …] or [{ at: [x, y, z], axis: [nx, ny, nz] }, …] in mm (a JSON string of the same is accepted); up is the body axis (x | y | z) that follows a point axis; keepOriginal keeps the source where it is; merge false keeps overlapping copies as separate bodies. Hardware: model one bolt in its own part, then call list_faces on the part it fastens, take the center and axis of each cylindrical hole face (filter by radius), and pass them here with up set to the bolt's own axis; when the holes move, run this again with the new centers. Empty or malformed points are bad_args. Working copy only; git_save commits. Writes (defaults): patternOnPoints(body, points, { up, keepOriginal, merge }) Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

points.description: Points as [[x, y, z], …] or [{ at: [x, y, z], axis: [nx, ny, nz] }, …] in mm (a JSON string of the same is accepted). For hardware: the center and axis of each hole from list_faces on the mating part.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: insert_pattern_points
